name: Cloud-Native, Passwordless-First
description: No on-premises Active Directory. Target state is passwordless and phishing-resistant everywhere; there is no password to fall back to, so password-adjacent controls matter less and phishing-resistant strength matters more.

SSPR001.Note: No on-prem AD and no password sign-in in scope for this tenant - there is no password to self-service reset.

STR001.Note: Passwordless-first tenants should treat phishing-resistant strength availability as a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

BOOT001.Note: With no password fallback, the phishing-resistant bootstrap path (self-service FIDO2 or TAP) is the only way a new user gets onto anything at all.
